title: Linen Midi & Cotton Maxi Dresses for Women
description: Pure linen midi dresses and cotton maxi dresses, including hand block print – breathable, made in Jaipur, sizes XS–4XL or free custom fit. Duties-paid shipping abroad.
intro: Pure linen midi dresses and cotton maxi dresses – made for warm days and holidays
heading: Choosing a summer dress

p: Our dresses are cut from breathable pure linen (midi length, with cotton lining) and cotton (maxi length, including a hand block print style). Linen stays cool and looks crisp; cotton feels soft and easy for everyday wear. Both are stitched in our own Jaipur unit, in sizes XS–4XL or to your measurements for free.

list: Linen: very breathable, dries fast, has a natural crisp texture – it creases, which is part of its charm.
Cotton: soft, easy to wash, holds prints and block-printed colour well.
For humid cities choose looser cuts and lighter colours; for holidays a midi length packs small and goes from beach to dinner.

p: Selected white linen dresses can be ordered in other colours from our shade card at the same price – see the linen dress colour guide.

faq: Is linen or cotton better for hot weather?
Both breathe well. Linen is cooler and dries faster; cotton is softer and creases less. Our guide compares them in detail.
Yes – our pure linen midi dresses have a cotton lining, so they are not see-through.
Can I order a dress in another colour?
Selected white linen styles can be made in other shade-card colours at the same price.
